slug: 噬主成魔万魂幡饮血开锋
content_zh:
阴九幽生来便是家族弃子，受尽折辱。
退婚大典上，未婚妻当众抽他魂血，只为炼制法器。
家族袖手旁观，父母被囚，仇敌哄笑。
濒死之际，他握住一块染血古幡碎片。
万魂幡认主，噬魂炼魄，以敌为食。
他炼仇敌之骨为基，抽其魂为幡灵，榨尽血肉为丹。
每个境界他都突破极境，佛魔道武四修合一。
秘境中绿茶仙子们娇笑设局，却不知他幡中囚着她们老祖。
当轮回崩塌，诸天颤抖，他立于魂幡之巅冷笑：
“当年辱我者，魂火不熄，永世为奴。”
---
阴九幽跪在青石板上。
青石板冷得刺骨，寒气蛇一样顺着膝盖骨缝往上钻，啃噬着早已麻木的骨髓。
偌大的林家演武场，黑压压挤满了人。
每一道目光都像淬了毒的针，密密麻麻扎在他单薄的后背上。
空气里弥漫着一种粘稠的、令人作呕的兴奋——看客们正热切期盼着一场精心策划的屠宰。
今日，是柳家嫡女柳如烟驾临林氏，当众退婚的日子。
更是她，要以阴九幽这“废物”
的魂与血，祭炼她那柄新得的“玄阴刺”
的大好时辰。

“九幽，”
一个冰冷得不带一丝人气的声音，从他头顶砸下来。
林家大长老林震岳，他的亲爷爷，端坐高台，眼皮耷拉着，仿佛在说一件微不足道的小事，“柳仙子天资绝世，未来不可限量。
你，区区凡骨，连引气入体都做不到，如何配得上？
今日割舍这桩孽缘，于你，于林家，都是解脱。
莫要怨恨。”
阴九幽的头颅垂得更低，枯草般杂乱的头发遮住了他所有表情。
怨恨？呵，他早就被抽干了，只剩下这副空荡荡的躯壳。
从记事起，怨恨就是他唯一的食粮。
怨恨将他生在这等无情无义的家族，怨恨那些流着相同血脉的“亲人”
们日复一日的拳脚、唾骂和“废物”
的诅咒。
若非父母以命相护，他早已化为一滩烂泥。
如今，父母也被囚在家族地牢深处，生死不知。
“解脱？”
他喉咙里滚出一声干涩的、近乎无声的冷笑。
“时辰到了！
一个尖利的声音刺破喧嚣。
柳如烟身边，一个穿着城主府执事袍服、三角眼的中年男人——城主府供奉赵无咎，不耐烦地催促道。
他看向阴九幽的眼神，如同看一块待宰的砧板肉。

柳如烟莲步轻移，走到阴九幽面前。
她一身素白纱裙，清丽绝俗，宛如月宫仙子。
只是那双秋水剪瞳深处，却淬着比万年玄冰更冷的漠然与贪婪。
她甚至懒得低头俯视这个跪着的“未婚夫”
content_en:
Yin Jiuyou was born as an abandoned son of his family and suffered all kinds of humiliation.
At the break-up ceremony, his fiancée drained his soul blood in public just to refine the magic weapon.
The family stood idly by, the parents were imprisoned, and the enemies laughed.
On the verge of death, he held a fragment of an ancient flag stained with blood.
The Ten Thousand Soul Banner recognizes its master, eats souls to refine souls, and feeds on enemies.
He refines the bones of his enemies into foundations, extracts their souls into banner spirits, and squeezes out his flesh and blood into elixirs.
In each realm, he broke through the extreme realm, and the four cultivations of Buddha, Demon, Taoism and Martial Arts were integrated into one.
In the secret realm, the green tea fairies were smiling and setting up a trap, but they didn't know that their ancestor was imprisoned in his flag.
When reincarnation collapsed and the heavens trembled, he stood on the top of the soul flag and sneered:
"Those who insulted me back then will never extinguish the fire in their souls and will be slaves forever."
---
Yin Jiuyou knelt on the bluestone.
The bluestone was bone-chillingly cold, and the cold air snaked its way up the seam of the kneecap, gnawing at the already numb bone marrow.
The huge Lin family martial arts arena was dark and crowded with people.
Every glance was like a poisoned needle, densely piercing his thin back.
There was a sticky, sickening excitement in the air - spectators eagerly anticipating an elaborate slaughter.
Today is the day when Liu Ruyan, the legitimate daughter of the Liu family, comes to the Lin family to break off the engagement in public.
It is she who wants to use Yin Jiuyou, a "trash"
Her soul and blood were sacrificed to refine her newly acquired "Xuanyin Thorn"
great time.
"Nine Netherworld,"
A voice that was so cold and unpopular came from above his head.
The eldest elder of the Lin family, Lin Zhenyue, his biological grandfather, was sitting on a high platform with his eyelids drooping, as if he was saying something trivial, "Fairy Liu is extremely talented and her future is limitless.
You, a mere mortal, can't even draw Qi into your body, how can you be worthy?
Letting go of this evil fate today will be a relief for you and the Lin family.
Don't be resentful. "
Yin Jiuyou's head hung lower, and his messy hair like withered grass covered all his expressions.
resentment? Oh, he had been drained long ago, leaving only this empty body.
For as long as he can remember, resentment has been his only food.
Resentment for being born into such a ruthless family, resentment for those "relatives" who share the same blood
Their fists, kicks, curses and "trash" day after day
The curse.
If his parents hadn't protected him with their lives, he would have turned into a puddle of mud.
Today, my parents are also imprisoned deep in the family dungeon, and they don’t know whether they are alive or dead.
"Relief?"
A dry, almost silent sneer rolled out of his throat.
"The time has come!
A sharp voice cut through the din.
Next to Liu Ruyan, a middle-aged man with triangular eyes wearing the deacon's robe of the City Lord's Mansion - the City Lord's Mansion enshrines Zhao Wujiu, urged impatiently.
The way he looked at Yin Jiuyou was like looking at a piece of meat waiting to be slaughtered on a chopping board.
Liu Ruyan moved lightly and walked to Yin Jiuyou.
She is dressed in a plain white gauze dress, which is as beautiful as a moon palace fairy.
It's just that in the depths of those autumn eyes, there is a cold indifference and greed that is colder than ten thousand years of black ice.
She didn't even bother to lower her head to look down at the kneeling "fiancé"
